contributions.claim: WHO and South African health department report suspected cruise-ship hantavirus outbreak with three dead and at least three others ill; at least one case confirmed, one patient in South African intensive care and two symptomatic evacuations being arranged.
contributions.attribution: WHO and South African health department via Guardian
contributions.uncertainty: Suspected outbreak attribution does not establish all deaths as confirmed hantavirus.

delta_expectations.reason: Initial packet establishes suspected outbreak, severity and pending response.

questions.claim: Investigation is ongoing into suspected outbreak; confirmation across affected passengers remains incomplete.

ambiguity_notes: Publication-order simulation: authentic availability unknown; supplied historical content may be backfilled or revised. Raw HTML includes a May 4 explainer link in a May 3 publication record; no inference of actual May 3 availability.
